sources_used.source: Edison Chamber of Commerce directory (ChamberMaster categories: manufacturing, wholesale, retail, banquet, photography, home & garden)
Loc8NearMe Edison listings (pet facilities, music, jewelry)
NJ MVC licensed driving school roster (PDF)
Web search (Exa / OpenAI) across Edison category queries

categories_thin: Independent hotels: Edison lodging is almost entirely branded (Sheraton, Hilton Garden Inn, Courtyard, Extended Stay); only E Hotel appears non-branded.
Labs and testing: only DDL NJ surfaced; Edison's other labs are branches of national firms.
Childcare: dominated by national franchises (Tutor Time, Primrose, Lightbridge, The Learning Experience, Big Blue Marble, Kumon), leaving few independents.
Art, dance and music schools: many exist but most publish only a phone or a web form and no street address, so several entries have address 'Unknown'.
Printing and signs: heavily franchised (FASTSIGNS, Minuteman Press, EmbroidMe, AlphaGraphics) so the independent count is small relative to local demand.
Pet retail: PetSmart/Petco dominate; independents here are grooming, boarding and sitting only.
caveats: Excluded as chains or franchises: Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, Tanishq, Raj Jewels, Virani, Kay, Zales, Sylvan, Mathnasium, C2 Education, JEI, Kumon, Genie Academy, Tutor Time, Primrose, Lightbridge, The Learning Experience, Big Blue Marble, Trek/Electra, FASTSIGNS, Minuteman Press, EmbroidMe, Color Me Mine, Barnes & Noble, Menlo Park Mall national tenants, Graham Packaging, Imperial Dade, Storopack, Cembre USA.
Excluded large multinationals with Edison sites: LyondellBasell, William Grant & Sons, Katoen Natie, Zebra Pen, Teva.
Oak Tree Road straddles the Edison/Iselin (Woodbridge) line; a few jewelry, saree and appliance shops listed there may sit in Iselin. Township should be confirmed before outreach.
Many manufacturing and wholesale entries come from a single chamber or bulk directory listing and are not independently confirmed as still operating.
Lou Rose Music Center and Music Forever share the phone 732-985-3333 and sit in the same family music-trade cluster; treat as possibly related rather than clean duplicates.
Some 'Edison' appliance-repair businesses are service-area listings rather than storefronts; flagged in their notes.
data_gaps: YellowPages.com, AllPages.com and AllBiz returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so their bulk Edison category lists could not be harvested page by page.
OpenStreetMap/Overpass was not usable from this environment, so no map-based cross-check of the address list.
Google Maps/Bing Maps place data could not be paginated stably; per-business review counts are missing for most entries.
The Edison Chamber's Education and Childcare categories returned no members, so those groups relied on web search only.
DDL NJ, Hotpack Global and the NJ Convention & Exposition Center may exceed the 500-staff cap; included and flagged for triage.
